D: A wisecracking Detroit cop goes to Beverly Hills to solve his best friend's murder.
P: Serve the bananas when Axel stuffs them up the cop car's exhaust.
S: overripe banana loaf with brown sugar and vanilla, sliced thick and toasted in butter

Mash 3 overripe bananas with 120g melted butter, 150g brown sugar, an egg and vanilla, fold in 200g self-raising flour and a pinch of salt, bake at 170C for 55 minutes. Slice thick and toast in butter.
Harrow Club smoked trout brioche toasts
crème fraîche, flaked fish and chives on toasted rounds, plus grapes rolled in goat's cheese

Toasted brioche rounds with crème fraîche, smoked trout and chives, plus grapes rolled in goat's cheese and crushed pistachios. Cut 16 rounds from 4 thick slices of brioche and toast at 180C for 6 minutes. Top each with crème fraîche, a flake of smoked trout and snipped chives. Wrap 16 seedless grapes in a thin layer of soft goat's cheese, roll in 50g finely crushed pistachios and chill 15 minutes. Serve both on a tray.
home turf, a long way from Beverly Hills
Cocktail franks in mini buns topped with a loose beef chilli (fine mince, onion, chilli powder, cumin, a little water simmered 45 minutes), mustard and raw onion.
M: Serge at the gallery desk, with the accent nobody can place

Grilled chicken, cos, parmesan, garlic croutons and a sharp anchovy dressing. Tear the bread into chunks, toss with 2 tbsp of the olive oil and 1 crushed garlic clove and bake at 200C for 10 minutes until golden. Blend the egg yolk, anchovies, the other garlic clove, mustard and lemon juice, then drizzle in the light olive oil until thick. Grate in half the parmesan. Slice the chicken in half through the middle, rub with the rest of the oil and salt and cook in a hot grill pan for 4 minutes a side. Rest and slice. Toss the cos leaves with the dressing and croutons, top with the chicken and shave over the rest of the parmesan.
the steak sandwich Axel puts on someone else's tab
Sirloin seared hard and sliced thin, caramelised onion, Swiss and horseradish mayo on a toasted brioche roll, fries on the side.
W: vanilla, chocolate and strawberry scoops, hot fudge, crushed pineapple, cream, nuts and a cherry
Split banana, three scoops (vanilla, chocolate, strawberry), hot fudge, crushed pineapple, strawberry sauce, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry.
K: Axel blags his way into the Beverly Palms

White rum blended with pineapple, coconut cream and lime until frosty, poured into tall glasses with a pineapple wedge and a cherry. Add 180ml white rum, 360ml pineapple juice, 200ml coconut cream, the juice of 1 lime and 3 cups of ice to a blender. Blend 30 seconds until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall glasses. Garnish each with a pineapple wedge on the rim and a cocktail cherry.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170C and line a small loaf tin. Mash the bananas and mix with the butter, sugar, egg and vanilla.
Fold in the flour and salt and spoon into the tin.
Bake until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool the loaf completely.
Cut thick slices, halve into bites and toast in a pan with the extra butter on both sides.

s.note: overripe banana loaf with brown sugar and vanilla, sliced thick and toasted in butter
s.how: Mash 3 overripe bananas and mix with 120g melted butter, 150g brown sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla extract. Fold in 200g self-raising flour and a pinch of salt. Spoon into a lined small loaf tin and bake at 170°C conventional for 55 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool completely. Cut four thick slices, halve each into bites and toast in a frying pan with 20g butter for 2 minutes per side. Save the remaining loaf for another day.

s.note: home turf, a long way from Beverly Hills
s.how: Brown 150g fine beef mince with half a finely diced onion in 1 tsp oil for 5 minutes. Stir in 1 tsp chilli powder, 1/2 tsp cumin and 150ml water. Simmer gently for 45 minutes, adding water if needed to keep a loose spoonable chilli. Heat 8 cocktail franks in a griddle pan for 5 minutes until piping hot. Fill 8 mini hot dog buns with the franks, chilli, 20g yellow mustard and the remaining half onion diced raw. Serve two sliders each.

m.note: the steak sandwich Axel puts on someone else's tab
m.how: Cut 600g potatoes into fries, toss with 1 tbsp oil and bake at 220°C conventional for 30 minutes, turning halfway. Slowly cook 2 sliced brown onions in 20g butter over medium-low heat for 20 minutes until caramelised. Mix 60g mayonnaise with 20g horseradish. Season 600g sirloin steak and sear hard in a hot pan with 1 tsp oil for about 3 minutes per side to your preferred doneness. Rest 8 minutes and slice thin. Toast 4 brioche rolls. Fill with steak, caramelised onions, 100g Swiss cheese and horseradish mayo. Serve fries alongside.

w.note: vanilla, chocolate and strawberry scoops, hot fudge, crushed pineapple, cream, nuts and a cherry
w.how: Split 4 bananas lengthways between four dishes. Put one 50ml scoop each of vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream into each dish. Gently melt 80g dark chocolate with 60ml thickened cream to make hot fudge. Softly whip another 100ml cream. Add 100g drained crushed pineapple, 80ml strawberry sauce, the hot fudge and whipped cream, dividing evenly. Finish with 30g chopped nuts and 4 cherries. Serve immediately.
